title: Ned Pegs the Rail
checkpoint: Reception Spring 1, week 4 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds ai, ee, igh

pages.illustration: Ned the duckling looking up at a long empty washing line strung across a garden.
A small pile of cloth bits and wooden pegs sitting on the grass under the washing line.

pages.text: Ned pegs a bit on the rail.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling using his bill to clip a small cloth square onto the washing line with a wooden peg.

pages.text: Ned pegs this bit. Ned pegs that bit.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling pegging up two more cloth bits along the washing line.

pages.text: Ned pegs six bits on the rail.
pages.illustration: The washing line now holding six small cloth squares in a neat row.

pages.text: The rail has lots on it.
pages.illustration: A wide view of the washing line completely filled with cloth squares, fluttering gently.

pages.text: Ned did it! Ned did a big job.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling standing proudly below the full washing line, chest out.
Ned the duckling curled up asleep on the grass under the full washing line.
